text:
Jordan: Heads up — GiftBridge sent an updated quote for their inference billing. They've moved us to a mixed model: monthly seat minimum + usage credits. pdf attached in thread. can someone look at the numbers?
Priya: I can take a look. do we have a sample invoice so we can map their SKU lines to our GL?
Jordan: Not yet, sales only sent the rate card. they said invoices will show 'seat_charge' and 'usage_tokens' lines.
Sam W: Quick note — our integration will be embedding-heavy for search ranking, so tokens >> seats. seats are mostly for admin users. rough projection: 3.5B embedding tokens/mo for initial rollout.
Tara: Procurement checklist: need SOC2 cert + 90-day pilot termination clause. if billing is mixed we should insist on monthly invoices with per-SKU breakdown. no quarterly lump sums.
Priya: ok. @Jordan can you ask sales for a sample invoice and a 12-month cost projection at our 3.5B tokens estimate? also request a CSV export format for invoice lines (we import to our billing tool).
Jordan: will do. also asking for a PO template and whether unused credits roll forward. sales was vague on roll-forward.
Sam W: negotiation levers we should try: 1) roll-forward credits for 12 months 2) overage cap at +20% of commit price 3) tiered per-token pricing after X tokens.
Tara: +1 to those. add SLA credits for downtime affecting inference. and ask for early-termination pro-rata refund on unused prepaid seats.
procure-bot: Vendor scorecard: GiftBridge currently has "Product Fit: B", "Security: A-", "Pricing Flexibility: C+". Link: https://redwood-internal/vend-score/GiftBridge
Priya: also want to run a quick pricing experiment ask: can they give us a pilot bucket of 500M tokens at discounted rate so we can validate costs? if yes, require invoice-level metering so we can compare projected vs actual.
Jordan: sales replied — they can do a pilot credit for 500M tokens but it's non-refundable and expires in 30 days. will push back on expiration + non-refundable.
Sam W: if they insist on expiry, ask to at least let credits convert to seat discounts if unused. simple calc snippet I sent to sales: `estimated_monthly_cost = seats*seat_rate + tokens*token_rate` — need a sample token_rate for our tiering ask.
Tara: thumbs up. once we have sample invoice and their response on roll-forward/expiry, I'll prepare an approval ask for legal + finance sign-off. Priya, can you draft a short decision memo (1-paragraph) capturing risk + ask?
Priya: yes, will draft and ping the group.
Jordan: filed request to sales at 1738204602 — awaiting sample invoice. pinging again if no reply by EOD PST. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam W: thanks. if they push fixed seats hard, we should run a sensitivity table (tokens +/-30%) to see cost delta. keep me in the loop.
Tara: sounds good. :thumbsup:
